targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM ops.metric WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' OR (stage LIKE 'aws_24h_%' OR run_id LIKE 'aws_24h_%') GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY max(metric_ts) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT COALESCE(max(metric_value), 0) AS value FROM ops.metric WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) AND metric_name IN ('gate_pass','consumer_lag_after');

panels.title: Processed / inserted / duplicate / retry / DLQ invariant

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM ops.metric WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' OR (stage LIKE 'aws_24h_%' OR run_id LIKE 'aws_24h_%') GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY max(metric_ts) DESC LIMIT 1), pivot AS (SELECT metric_name, max(metric_value) AS value FROM ops.metric WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) GROUP BY metric_name) SELECT metric, value FROM (VALUES ('processed', COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_processed'),0)), ('inserted', COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_inserted'),0)), ('duplicate', COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_duplicate'),0)), ('retry', COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_retry'),0)), ('dlq', COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_dlq'),0)), ('invariant_delta', ABS(COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_processed'),0)-COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_inserted'),0)-COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_duplicate'),0)-COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_dlq'),0)))) AS t(metric, value);

SELECT metric_ts AS time, stage || ':' || metric_name AS metric, metric_value AS value FROM ops.metric WHERE (stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' OR (stage LIKE 'aws_24h_%' OR run_id LIKE 'aws_24h_%')) AND metric_ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY 1;

WITH recent AS (SELECT run_id, max(metric_ts) AS latest_ts FROM ops.metric WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' OR (stage LIKE 'aws_24h_%' OR run_id LIKE 'aws_24h_%') GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY latest_ts DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT r.latest_ts, m.run_id, max(m.stage) AS stage, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name IN ('producer_accepted','producer_emitted')) AS producer_accepted, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name='consumer_processed') AS processed, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name='consumer_inserted') AS inserted, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name='consumer_duplicate') AS duplicate, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name='consumer_retry') AS retry, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name='consumer_dlq') AS dlq, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name IN ('consumer_lag_after','lag_after')) AS lag_after FROM recent r JOIN ops.metric m ON m.run_id = r.run_id GROUP BY r.latest_ts, m.run_id ORDER BY r.latest_ts DESC;

WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM ops.metric WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' OR (stage LIKE 'aws_24h_%' OR run_id LIKE 'aws_24h_%') GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY max(metric_ts) DESC LIMIT 1), pivot AS (SELECT metric_name, max(metric_value) AS value FROM ops.metric WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) AND metric_name IN ('consumer_duplicate','consumer_reprocessed') GROUP BY metric_name) SELECT metric, value FROM (VALUES ('consumer_duplicate', COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_duplicate'),0)), ('consumer_reprocessed', COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_reprocessed'),0))) AS t(metric, value);
